messages:
maya: running into a weird one — embedding requests via the Node SDK sometimes return 404, but curl to the same endpoint succeeds. anyone seen this? :confused:

jon: can you paste the exact curl + sdk call you used? also which sdk version?

maya: repro below. sdk@0.28.1. curl (works):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood-inference.dev/v1/embeddings?model=text-embed-001&user=team123" \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"input":"hello world"}'
```
node sdk (404):
```js
const r = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.TOKEN });
await r.embeddings.create({ model: 'text-embed-001', input: 'hello world', user: '' }); // user intentionally empty string in sampleapp
```
I couldn't paste the full headers but same auth. curl returns 200+embedding, sdk throws HTTPError: 404 Not Found.

alex: hmm the empty `user` param is suspicious. some of our routers treat empty query params differently. what does prod ingress log show?

deploy-bot: [logs] 2026-02-12T16:18:32Z GET /v1/embeddings?model=text-embed-001&user= -> 404 (route not found)

sam: interesting — SDK code used to omit query params when value is falsy, but curl had explicit `user=` in query so it's present. SDK is probably removing it and the backend's mux expects `user` param to be present for the linted embed route (legacy behavior).

jon: can you try calling SDK but force `user: null` vs `user: undefined` vs not including the field? need to confirm whether omission vs empty-string changes behavior.

maya: quick test results:
- `user: undefined` => 404
- `user: null` => 404
- `user: ''` => 404 (sdk serializes it to ?user= but our http client then strips empty kv?)
- omit field entirely in SDK call => 200 (but sampleapp relied on empty to attach metadata in later code path)
So inconsistent. curl with `?user=` -> 200 as before.

alex: that points at the HTTP client layer or a middleware that normalizes querystring. the SDK's wrapper may be using a qs lib with skipEmpty=true or similar.

sam: also worth noting: SDK retries for 5xx but not for 404. so different behavior could lead to different surface for flaky infra vs param issues.

jon: assign to eng-runtime to investigate query serialization + backward compatibility. short-term fix: have SDK preserve explicit empty-string params and add a unit test. long-term: server should be tolerant of missing vs empty query param — route should not be this brittle.

maya: logging a minimal reproducer in GH issue with sampleapp + curl. https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/issues/412 (WIP)

alex: proposed patch: set qs.stringify options to { skipNull: false, skipEmptyString: false } in SDK http layer. add tests that call /embeddings with `user: ''` and expect same behavior as curl. Also update sampleapp to avoid depending on empty-string sentinel.

sam: note for product docs: mention that `user` param is optional but if set to empty string semantics may differ across clients until this is fixed. call it out in migration notes.

maya: thanks — will open PR with test + changelog. moving sampleapp to set user: 'sampleapp' to unblock onboarding. :thumbsup:

jon: followups: 1) eng-runtime to make route tolerant (ticket created). 2) devex to update sampleapp + quickstart. 3) sdk team to patch qs behavior and cut a patch release.

maya: created PR #578 and linked the issue. leaving this thread here for traces.

sam: thx — good catch. small DX things like this are painful for first-time users.

maya: yep, totally. the sampleapp onboarding failed for a user yesterday, now we know why. closing after PR merges. :white_check_mark:
